The background features a textured wall with the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo and professional certificates. The lighting is bright and professionally set, creating a clean studio look. The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the man, revealing a young face with a slight smile as he looks at the woman and then toward the camera. He maintains a polite and attentive posture. Skincare product bottles and a YouTube award are visible on shelves in the background. (3) The woman continues to speak animatedly, using frequent hand gestures and counting on her fingers to emphasize her points. The man listens carefully, occasionally nodding. Numerical text overlays appear floating above their heads as they discuss registration numbers. The setting remains the well-lit clinic office environment. The woman's facial expressions are very expressive and high-energy. (4) The final phase shows a static white background with the clinic's logo and contact information. The layout includes the clinic's name, a LINE social handle, a telephone number, and two branch addresses in Sanchong and Zhongshan. There are no people visible in this final informational graphic, which uses flat, clean graphic design elements.
